blocks.text: Browser-based 3D design tool for interactive web experiences

Spline brings 3D design to the web in a way that traditional tools like Blender and Cinema 4D never could - directly in the browser, with real-time collaboration, and export options built for web developers. Create 3D objects, animate them, add interactivity, and embed the result on your website.

For product teams wanting to add 3D elements to landing pages, onboarding flows, or marketing sites, Spline eliminates the need for specialized 3D artists. The learning curve is gentler than professional 3D software, with results that are often more web-appropriate.

The interactive capabilities set Spline apart from static 3D tools. Objects can respond to mouse movement, scroll position, and clicks - creating experiences that feel dynamic and engaging without complex WebGL programming.
Full 3D editing environment running entirely in the browser
Add mouse, scroll, and click interactions to 3D objects
Multiple designers working on the same 3D scene simultaneously
Embed 3D scenes with a single script tag or React component
Timeline-based and state-based animations with easing controls
Physically-based materials, lighting, and environment controls
3D elements on landing pages consistently improve engagement in our client projects. Spline makes this accessible without hiring specialized 3D developers or artists.
Our team can integrate Spline into your workflow and automate the repetitive parts.
